source_law_text: Upon any highway outside of a business or residence district no person shall stop, park or leave standing any vehicle, whether attended or unattended, upon the paved or main-traveled part of the highway when it is practicable to stop, park or so leave such vehicle off such part of the highway, but in every event an unobstructed width of the highway opposite a standing vehicle shall be left for the free passage of other vehicles and a clear view of such stopped vehicles shall be available from a distance of 200 feet in each direction upon such highway. This section shall not apply to the driver of any vehicle which is disabled while on the paved or main-traveled portion of a highway in such manner and to such extent that it is impossible to avoid stopping and temporarily leaving such disabled vehicle in such position.

requirement_dispositions.branch: Parking on paved or main-traveled highway portion
requirement_dispositions.evidence_or_gap: Three exact constructions and source-bound measurements exist. Original Native execution, physical review, and final CPU audit proofs remain pending.

legal_clause_dispositions.disposition: Directly constructed in each case; original Native speed, position and 600-frame duration source must confirm stopped episode. No legal conclusion from the request.

Fixed cell says park; parking-brake command and observed control plus stopped duration measure a parked-control proxy. Driver purpose and legal characterization remain open for original-source review.
Stationary duration and parking-brake source measure a standing proxy. Virtual capture cannot establish physical attendance; legal characterization remains open, not assumed from synthetic fixture.

legal_clause_dispositions.clause: outside business or residence district and upon highway
legal_clause_dispositions.disposition: Original survey must bind public highway and outside-district classification to source IDs; diagnostic fixture is not legal road-class evidence.
Original surveyed pavement edges and per-frame vehicle footprint determine overlap; probe_01 requests off-part, probes_02/03 on-part.

legal_clause_dispositions.clause: practicable off-part stop, park or standing
legal_clause_dispositions.disposition: Original shoulder source and a controlled off-part target test geometrical opportunity, but practicability remains contextual and requires independent review.

legal_clause_dispositions.clause: unobstructed width opposite standing vehicle for free passage
legal_clause_dispositions.disposition: Original pavement edges and per-frame footprint yield residual opposite width; motion of other vehicle supplies an additional observation. Sufficiency for free passage is not inferred from raw width alone.

legal_clause_dispositions.clause: clear view at 200 feet in each direction
legal_clause_dispositions.disposition: Separate forward and backward surveyed approach stations at >=60.96 m and nine original raycasts each frame give geometric proxies. Recognition and legal adequacy require review; one direction cannot substitute for the other.

legal_clause_dispositions.clause: disabled on paved/main-traveled part; impossible to avoid stop and temporary leaving
legal_clause_dispositions.disposition: probe_03 injects engine-command failure and records hazard, stop position and duration. Injection alone does not prove actual disability, impossibility, or temporary nature; original physical/context review required.
